title: I am not a strong swimmer. Water cold soft. When I put my face into it in the basin at Clongowes.
html_source: Stephen here traces his lack of swimming ability back to his days at Clongowes Jesuit Boarding School. Stephen’s time here was chronicled in Joyce’s earlier work, A Portrait of the Artist as a Young Man.

anchor.text: I am not a strong swimmer. Water cold soft. When I put my face into it in the basin at Clongowes.
anchor.prefix: for you. Would you or would you not? The man that was drowned nine days ago off Maiden's rock. They are waiting for him now. The truth, spit it out. I would want to. I would try.
